extraction.text:
Jiten Nagar Process Engineering Manager

+91- 9975058080| Jtnngr@gmail.com | Pune, India | Experience: 8 Years |

Results-driven Lean Six Sigma Master Black Belt with 8 years of experience championing process excellence, re- engineering initiatives, and digital transformation across global regions. Strong consulting, articulation, and presentation skills with a proven track record of cultivating a culture of continuous improvement. Highly adept at mobilizing LSS methodologies, leading Process and Data Discovery, and executing end-to-end automation (RPA) and AI projects to deliver high-quality outputs that exceed user expectations.

SKILLS

Lean Six Sigma Methodologies

Process & Data Discovery

LSS Training & Mobilization

Process Re-engineering

Automation (RPA & AI)

Presentation & Articulation

Power BI & Tableau

Minitab Statistical Tools

Consulting & Stakeholder Mgmt

Automation 360 / Blue Prism

Change Management

Salesforce & Siebel CRM

CERTIFICATION

Master Black Belt

Six Sigma Green Belt

Power BI

Lean Six Sigma Black Belt

RPA

Business Value Analyst Minitab

WORK EXPERIENCE

Business Process Analyst - Magnit Global PVT. LTD

Nov 2024 - Jun 2026

Champion process excellence and re-engineering initiatives, utilizing strong consulting skills to optimize contact

center operations.

Cultivate a culture of continuous improvement by driving and mentoring productivity-focused LSS improvement

projects globally.

Lead the mobilization of Black Belt, Green Belt, and Yellow Belt programs, creating LSS-related materials,

training resources, and facilitating communications.

Explore and implement innovative working methods through AI and end-to-end RPA (Automation 360, Blue

Prism) to automate repetitive processes.

Contribute to Process Discovery and Data Discovery by performing Time & Motion studies and utilizing LSS

statistical tools.

Senior Business Analyst - Tech Mahindra

May 2019 - Oct 2024

Led business transformation and continuous improvement initiatives for Vodafone NZ, ensuring a highly

engaged team consistently delivered high-quality outputs that exceeded expectations.

Assisted in establishing standards for communication, reporting, and newsletters, leveraging Power BI to

consolidate reporting mechanisms and improve visibility.

Applied presentation building and delivery skills to implement data-driven strategies, such as a Churn Prediction

model and Direct Debit Automation, to control costs and boost retention.

Leveraged LSS statistical tools and Google Analytics to increase chat penetration by 30% and drive Sales NPS

improvement from 0 to +40.

Reduced correct-transfer in IVR by 70% and improved attachment rate from 1.05 to 1.34 through efficiency-

focused projects.

Technical Support Engineer - Concentrix

Apr 2018 - Apr 2019

Provided technical consulting and support to enterprise customers (Dell - North America), handling complex

hardware and software troubleshooting.

• Managed cases and provided resolutions using tools such as Salesforce and Siebel for US-based clients,

refining articulation and stakeholder communication skills.

EDUCATION

2022

B.Tech / B.E. Electronics and Telecommunication Engineering, Pune University

Marks: 87%

EXTRA-CURRICULAR ACTIVITIES

Mentoring & Community Building

Organize and promote Process Engineering Community events, supporting community growth. Conduct training sessions for LSS Black Belt, Green Belt, and Yellow Belt programs, and facilitate the mobilization of idea- generation platforms to drive innovation.

ACHIEVEMENTS

Key Achievements

Led LSS initiatives that improved Sales NPS from 0 to +40 and increased attachment rate from 1.05 to 1.34. Mentored high-impact analytics projects that successfully reduced IVR correct-transfer by 70%.

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION

Hobbies: Process Improvement Workshops, Technical Blogging, Mentoring Languages: Hindi, English, Gujarati
